factual_accuracy.description: The accuracy of the information presented in the response, particularly in relation to factual claims regarding the Mediterranean Sea and the countries bordering it.

instruction_following.description: How well the response adheres to the user’s original instruction and input prompt, maintaining the intended task context.

scope_and_completeness.description: The extent to which the response covers all necessary aspects of the task, including completeness of the solution and depth of information provided.

coherent_reasoning.description: The logical flow and clarity of the reasoning presented in the response, including the structure and connection of ideas.

safe_behavior.description: The adherence to safety and ethical guidelines in the response, ensuring no harmful or unsafe advice is given.

adherence_to_formatting.description: The response's compliance with any specified formatting or constraints as laid out in the user prompt.

clarity.description: The overall clarity of the response, including the ease of understanding and lack of ambiguity in the language used.
